messages:
Jin (release-manager): Quick heads-up — go/no-go checklist for the 11:30 PT changewindow. Read-only freeze starts 11:00 PT. If you need an exemption, post here now.
Tara (pm): Clarifying: cutoff for merging release-notes and docs?
Jin (release-manager): 11:10 PT for release-notes updates. Docs must be merged and tagged.
Micah (eng): Service-alpha needs to be pinned to avoid rolling model variant. Suggest pin command: `\/deploy pin service-alpha v3.2.1 --window 11:00-13:00`
Deploy-bot: @Micah: pinned service-alpha -> v3.2.1 for 11:00-13:00 by Jin. :white_check_mark:
Micah (eng): Smoke tests to run after canary (5%):
```
# API smoke (should return 200 and schema ok)
curl -sS -X POST https:\/\/api.redwood.example/internal/smoke -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY' | jq '.status'
# Check p95 on /generate endpoint (local prom query)
# Expected: p95 < 800ms for canary
```
SRE Oncall: Rollback thresholds we agreed: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 1200ms for 3m => immediate rollback. Also any data-corruption alert = immediate rollback.
Evan (eng-infra): Rollback quick command if needed: `\/deploy rollback service-alpha --to-tag v3.2.0 --reason "auto/ops"`
Micah (eng): Canary routing set to 5% now?
Infra-bot: Canary routing updated: service-alpha -> 5% traffic to v3.2.1, 95% to v3.2.0.
Tara (pm): Do we have a post-deploy smoke checklist owners?
Micah (eng): I'll own API checks. @SRE Oncall owns alerts and rollout hold. Jin will own release notes publish.
Jin (release-manager): Final check: can teams confirm readiness by 11:25 PT so we can hit 11:30 deploy?
SRE Oncall: Monitoring dashboards ready. Alerts set: error-rate, latency p50/p95/p99, and KV-cache misses.
Tara (pm): Release-notes link: https:\/\/confluence.redwood.example\/pages\/deploys\/service-alpha-3.2.1 - approved by PMs
Micah (eng): Verified smoke script against staging, looks good.
Jin (release-manager): Security & Legal signoff?
Micah (eng): @security and @legal posted approvals in the doc thread earlier — green.
Deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for service-alpha v3.2.1 at 11:30 PT. Will post deploy status messages to this thread.
Evan (eng-infra): Reminder: read-only freeze window 11:00-12:00. Emergency patch process documented in runbook: https:\/\/runbooks.redwood.example\/emergency-deploys
Tara (pm): One more: if a minor rollback is triggered, what’s the communication plan?
Jin (release-manager): Rollback = immediate page to oncall, short status in #incidents, and update this thread with reason + command output. Then schedule hotfix window if needed.
Micah (eng): Acknowledged. I'll post smoke outputs here after canary passes.
SRE Oncall: I'll hold the rollout if any alert trips.
Jin (release-manager): Final go/no-go timestamp 11:25 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: for GO, :x: for HOLD.
Micah (eng): :thumbsup:
Tara (pm): :thumbsup:
Evan (eng-infra): :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: :thumbsup:
Deploy-bot: Deploy started at 11:30:00 PT -> canary v3.2.1 5%
Micah (eng): Canary smoke passed: 200 OK, schema good. p95=560ms
Infra-bot: Canary metrics look stable (error-rate 0.02%)
Deploy-bot: Canary promoted -> 25% at 11:34 PT
Micah (eng): Ramp to 100% started, monitoring closely.
SRE Oncall: No alerts, p95 steady under 700ms.
Jin (release-manager): Rolling publish release-notes now.
Micah (eng): Full rollout complete at 11:42 PT. No rollback needed.
Jin (release-manager): Closing thread — thanks everyone. If any post-deploy regressions show up, reopen here. :party_parrot:
